input.quote: During the term of this Agreement, the Licensor shall have the right (the "Right of First Refusal"), for a period (the "Exercise Period") expiring at 11:59 PM (Eastern Time) on the fifth (5th) business day after the giving of written notice by the Licensee that it has received a bonafide offer from a third party to (ii) purchase all or substantially all of the assets of Licensee
input.rationale: The fee articles (Article V user-fee tiers, Supplemental Payments, rebate shares) contain no best-price or best-terms undertaking by Licensee, so pricing is clean. The one MFN-family obligation burdening us is Article XXII: we must disclose any bona fide third-party offer for our assets or control and then afford Licensor five business days to take that transaction on the same terms — a right-to-match/most-favoured-offer mechanic in Vendor's favour. It is not limited to a defined product, runs for the whole term (36 months plus extensions, far beyond 12 months) and has no like-for-like comparison carve-outs, so it fails every fallback element and is walk-away territory. We take the preferred position and strike the mechanic and its tail sentence, leaving only a negation that Licensor has no right of first refusal or right to match a third-party offer. No affirmative transfer permission or notice waiver is added, so the Article XX Change of Control consent regime and the Article XXIV(c) assignment consent survive unchanged; "Right of First Refusal" and "Exercise Period" appear nowhere else, so no reference is orphaned.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.

proposal.summary: Strike Article XXII's right-of-first-refusal mechanic and its tail sentence, leaving only a negation of the matching right
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have struck Article XXII's disclosure and right-to-match mechanic, together with its tail sentence, and left only a negation confirming that Licensor has no right of first refusal or right to match a third-party offer, because our playbook accepts no most-favoured-nation or matching obligation benefiting the Vendor. No affirmative transfer permission is added, so the Article XX Change of Control and Article XXIV(c) assignment consent requirements continue to apply unchanged.

ops.oldText: ARTICLE XXII RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL During the term of this Agreement, the Licensor shall have the right (the "Right of First Refusal"), for a period (the "Exercise Period") expiring at 11:59 PM (Eastern Time) on the fifth (5th) business day after the giving of written notice by the Licensee that it has received a bonafide offer from a third party to (ii) purchase all or substantially all of the assets of Licensee; or (ii) to engage in a merger or consolidation in which Licensee is not the surviving corporation or in which, if Licensee is the surviving corporation, the owners of Licensee immediately prior to the consummation of such merger or consolidation do not, immediately after consummation of such merger or consolidation, own stock or other securities of Licensee that possess a majority of the voting power of all Licensee's outstanding stock and other securities and the power to elect a majority of the members of Licensee's board of directors.
ops.newText: ARTICLE XXII NO RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL

ops.oldText: In the event the Licensor declines or fails to exercise in full the Right of First Refusal before the expiration of the Exercise Period, the
ops.newText: Licensor shall have no right of first refusal and no right to match any third-party offer to purchase the assets of, or to merge or consolidate with, the

ops.oldText: Licensee shall have the right to consummate the transaction with the third party.
